name: hagia-sophia
description: Mapped buttress apron, high tympana, two main half-domes and lateral exedrae, lead roof skins, brick southeast minaret and unequal pale-stone minarets; southern Ottoman tombs remain separate.
attribution: Survey plans © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0. Architectural geometry originally authored for Vearth.

audit.dimension_uncertainty: Published dome diameter describes the interior; roof exterior uses the measured source dome center with a 32.2m outer diameter. Minaret heights and small tomb details are visual estimates; unequal profiles and source positions are retained.
audit.orientation: Source footprints in east/north metric coordinates; all component rotations baked into vertices.
audit.grounding: Estimated39.0m west-entry floor, independent local tomb thresholds, and buried masonry supports; calibration and raw approach samples in mosque-floor-calibrations.json.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
